rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: opaque inputs became two to eight output items without bounded water uptake, biomass yield, liquor, off-gas, or residue streams.

route_findings.finding: Reject: atom balance alone does not justify catalyst-free, low-pressure ammonia synthesis, sulfur-dioxide oxidation, or acetylene hydrogenation.
Reject: the authored mixer encodes neither the high-energy initiation needed for N2/O2 conversion nor controlled initiation and hazard handling for H2/Cl2.
Reject: neutral elemental or molecular packets are treated as free ions/radicals without charge, counterion, electrochemical, or residue contracts.
Reject: generic hydrocarbon adjacency or a fuel-use output does not define balanced synthesis, polymerization, exhaust, or residue streams.
Reject: authored packets lose hydrogen or omit required water, oxidation, or disproportionation coproducts.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: These seventeen routes are disabled because they are unbalanced, charge-undefined, process-unsupported, or adjacency-only under the 250 mB formula-unit packet policy.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: PNCR containment is necessary for a future corrected route but does not itself establish reaction feasibility or bounded residues.
rejected_recipe_families.gas_destination_contract: No rejected route establishes safe gas delivery or escape; redesign requires explicit contained outputs and later gas oracle evidence.

route_findings.finding: Reject: direct elemental oxidation does not produce free carbonate or phosphate anions without charge, counterion, and process contracts.
Reject: direct carbon-plus-hydrogen adjacency lacks a plausible catalyst, feedstock pathway, process conditions, and residue contract.
Reject: direct sulfur-plus-hydrogen adjacency lacks an established contained industrial route and hazard contract.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Although corrected coefficients can conserve named atoms, these six routes remain rejected because graph adjacency and balance alone do not establish chemically grounded synthesis.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: PNCR may own a future conditioned contained route, but no disabled route creates a finished elemental metal or receives authority approval.
rejected_recipe_families.gas_destination_contract: Future redesign must specify contained product delivery or uncontained escape to Latent and remain pending gas oracle evidence.

route_findings.finding: Reject: unrelated slime, kelp, sulfur, carbon, and ethanol packets become two manufactured seals without a material composition, binder yield, tooling, or residue contract.
Reject: sugar, elemental carbon, and water become ethanol with only probabilistic carbon-dioxide residue, so carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen are neither deterministically balanced nor process-grounded.

Reject: elemental metal plus a free anion is formula adjacency, not a bounded reaction with charge, counterion, redox, and residue accounting; calcium carbonate already has an approved lime-and-CO2 fixation authority.
Reject: elemental copper plus free nitrate packets omits the acid medium, copper oxidation, nitrogen-oxide products, water, and charge accounting required by the named salt route.

Reject in this authored form: atom balance does not authorize an open Create basin for volatile or toxic arsenic, mercury, sulfur-vapor, and carbon-disulfide processing; correct physical phases, sealed containment, and hazard behavior require redesign and oracle evidence.
Reject: carbon disulfide plus paper becoming two string omits alkali activation, cellulose dissolution and regeneration, bath liquor, sulfur residues, and bounded fiber yield.
Reject: one opaque salt packet plus water becoming six bone meal items is generic fertilizer adjacency and multiplication without mineral composition, moisture, yield, or residue accounting.

rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: All ten routes fail deterministic conservation, shared packet yield, required residue, physical-phase, containment, or process evidence despite some nominal formula matches.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_finding: Create may handle open mixing and shaping, but volatile/toxic synthesis belongs in a future contained process and manufactured seals require a bounded component contract.
rejected_recipe_families.review_scope: Definitions remain as auditable source markers but are gated before recipe registration. No behavioral, hazard, or container claim is approved.

rejected_recipe_families.exact_material_purpose: The retired generator attempted formula-derived formation of named ChemLib compounds from registered elemental or gaseous components.
rejected_recipe_families.fixed_mass_finding: Rejected: formula lookup establishes nominal composition but does not establish a common fixed-mass packet, correct reaction conditions, charge state, complete acid residues, or deterministic gas transfer.
rejected_recipe_families.source_status: Definitions remain as auditable source context, but BC_FULL_CHEM_FORMULA_ROUTES_ENABLED is false and registration exits before emitting any family member.
rejected_recipe_families.industrial_authority_boundary: Create or PNCR machine selection does not confer authority; each future compound route requires its own bounded material purpose and reaction adjudication.
rejected_recipe_families.required_followup: Redesign only useful compounds as bounded material-specific cohorts, then obtain fresh registration and behavior evidence.
